description: the 2-cube's three edges at the corner (2, 2, 2) filleted in one call at r 0.2: the sphere corner, an octant through the ball's centre (2 - r, 2 - r, 2 - r), which Open CASCADE builds and Arris refuses as Reason::VertexBlend until the sphere corner lands (plans/fillet-and-chamfer step 9); each edge loses (1 - pi/4) r^2 along 2 - r and the corner cube r^3 (1 - pi/6)
